python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
with open('project_kickoff.ics', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Basic structural checks
checks = {
    'BEGIN:VCALENDAR': 'BEGIN:VCALENDAR' in content,
    'END:VCALENDAR': content.rstrip().endswith('END:VCALENDAR'),
    'VERSION 2.0': 'VERSION:2.0' in content,
    'BEGIN:VEVENT': 'BEGIN:VEVENT' in content,
    'END:VEVENT': 'END:VEVENT' in content,
    'UID present': 'UID:' in content,
    'DTSTAMP present': 'DTSTAMP:' in content,
    'DTSTART present': 'DTSTART;' in content,
    'DTEND present': 'DTEND;' in content,
    'SUMMARY present': 'SUMMARY:' in content,
    'VALARM present': 'BEGIN:VALARM' in content,
    'balanced VCALENDAR': content.count('BEGIN:VCALENDAR') == content.count('END:VCALENDAR') == 1,
    'balanced VEVENT': content.count('BEGIN:VEVENT') == content.count('END:VEVENT') == 1,
    'balanced VALARM': content.count('BEGIN:VALARM') == content.count('END:VALARM') == 1,
}

all_ok = True
for name, ok in checks.items():
    print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}: {name}")
    all_ok = all_ok and ok

# Verify event times
dtstart = re.search(r'DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:(\d{8}T\d{6})', content)
dtend = re.search(r'DTEND;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:(\d{8}T\d{6})', content)
start, end = dtstart.group(1), dtend.group(1)
print(f"\nStart: {start}")
print(f"End:   {end}")
print(f"Duration: 2 hours: {'PASS' if start == '20260817T100000' and end == '20260817T120000' else 'FAIL'}")

print(f"\nOverall: {'VALID' if all_ok else 'INVALID'}")
EOF
